title: RE60022: Human Reliability
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Human factors theory, man-machine function allocation, human factors in design,
control panel design, location of control and displays, illumination and noise
levels, labels, location of components, safety requirement accessibility etc.
quantitative techniques for human factor data collection, human factors in
production and in field testing, measurement and prediction of human
reliability, factors affecting Human Reliability.
